title: Passage 48
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Would you be able to sleep with one eye open?
sentences.cn: 你能睁着一只眼睛睡觉吗？

sentences.en: Bottlenose dolphins can.
sentences.cn: 宽吻海豚可以。

sentences.en: When they sleep, only half of their brain goes to sleep.
sentences.cn: 当它们睡觉时，大脑只有一半进入睡眠状态。

sentences.en: They sleep with one eye open to stay safe.
sentences.cn: 它们睁着一只眼睛睡觉，以保证安全。

sentences.en: Half of their brain sleeps for about two hours before the other half gets a chance to sleep.
sentences.cn: 一半大脑进入睡眠大约两个小时后，它们的另一侧大脑才有机会进入睡眠。

sentences.en: Dolphins are not fish—they are mammals.
sentences.cn: 海豚不是鱼类，它们是哺乳动物。

sentences.en: The smallest dolphin is about 50 kilos heavy, while the largest kind of dolphin weighs up to 10 tons.
sentences.cn: 最小的海豚重约50千克，而最大的海豚可重达10吨。

sentences.en: These mammals have lungs.
sentences.cn: 这些哺乳动物有肺。

sentences.en: They have to go to the surface of the water to get fresh air.
sentences.cn: 它们必须浮出水面呼吸新鲜空气。

sentences.en: These energetic animals can be seen near the coast, sometimes swimming alongside boats.
sentences.cn: 我们可以在海岸附近看到这些精力充沛的动物，有时它们还会在船边游。

sentences.en: Dolphins don't lay eggs.
sentences.cn: 海豚不产卵。

sentences.en: Their young are born alive, and they drink milk from their mothers.
sentences.cn: 它们的幼崽是活体出生的，并且会喝母亲的奶。

sentences.en: Dolphins are smart and brave.
sentences.cn: 海豚聪明勇敢。

sentences.en: Some dolphins save people from shark attacks.
sentences.cn: 有些海豚会在鲨鱼攻击人类时救助他们。

sentences.en: They are able to solve many problems and even use tools to catch fish.
sentences.cn: 它们能解决很多问题，甚至还能使用工具捕鱼。

sentences.en: But their cleverness doesn't end there.
sentences.cn: 但它们的聪明远不止于此。

sentences.en: Dolphins can also pass on anything they learn to other dolphins.
sentences.cn: 海豚还能把自己学到的东西传授给其他海豚。

sentences.en: They show great teamwork.
sentences.cn: 它们表现出很强的团队合作能力。

sentences.en: They communicate with each other using sounds like whistles and clicks.
sentences.cn: 它们用口哨声、咔嗒声等声音相互交流。

sentences.en: Maybe they make sentences just as humans do!
sentences.cn: 也许它们也像人类一样会说句子！

sentences.en: Dolphins know the "voices" of other dolphins and even know exactly from whom the sounds are.
sentences.cn: 海豚能分辨出其他海豚的“声音”，甚至准确知道声音来自谁。

sentences.en: They can also know themselves in a mirror and check different parts of their bodies in it.
sentences.cn: 它们还能认出镜子中的自己，并检查身体的不同部位。

sentences.en: However, dolphins have been facing danger from humans.
sentences.cn: 然而，海豚一直面临着来自人类的威胁。

sentences.en: There are people shooting them with their guns, causing wounds that make them bleed to death.
sentences.cn: 有人用枪射杀它们，导致它们受伤，流血而亡。

sentences.en: We should protect the smart animal for a better future, not only for theirs, but also for ours.
sentences.cn: 我们应该保护这种聪明的动物，以创造更美好的未来，不仅是为了它们，也是为了我们。
